_about: Known data-contract violations on master when WP-F step 1 landed (2026-11-17). Each entry is rule|id|field|original value: only that exact value is exempt. Reported as warnings, not errors. WP-F step 3 fixes them through the gate and removes each entry; an entry that no longer occurs is an error, so this list only shrinks. Trusted configuration: it cannot change in a PR that changes data (except by removal).
